html:
Rotgut's Drool Covered Microphone
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  One-handed Mace
Class:  Fighter
Damage:  varies with item level

Rotgut's Drool Covered Microphone is a fighter one-handed mace.

This microphone is covered with drool! It not only messes up the sound of your voice potentially Butchering the song, but your opponent as well.

This rainbow is specific to Rotgut the Bloated's lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for that dungeon. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Endurance
  • + Divine Damage
  • + Melee Damage
  • + % Enemy Stun Chance
  • + Total Health
  • + Butcher proc

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
